scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @portfolio-drz/frontend" "npm run start:dev -w @portfolio-drz/backend"
scripts.rustfs:start: test -x "$HOME/rustfs/bin/rustfs" || { echo 'Install the native RustFS binary first.'; exit 1; }; test -f .env || { echo 'Create the root .env first.'; exit 1; }; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; "$HOME/rustfs/bin/rustfs" server --address 127.0.0.1:9000 --console-enable --console-address 127.0.0.1:9001 "$HOME/rustfs/data"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio-drz/frontend && npm run build -w @portfolio-drz/backend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run start -w @portfolio-drz/frontend" "npm run start -w @portfolio-drz/backend"
